name: abtars
description: Agentic framework for connecting LLMs to messaging platforms, with persistent memory, skills, scheduled tasks, self-healing supervision, and distributed multi-agent collaboration

scripts.build: tsc && rm -rf dist/components/dashboard/public && cp -r src/components/dashboard/public dist/components/dashboard/public && git log -1 --format='{"hash":"%h","date":"%ci"}' > dist/build-info.json
scripts.bundle: rm -rf bundle && node esbuild.config.js && node scripts/check-bundle-boundary.mjs && rm -rf bundle/public && cp -r src/components/dashboard/public bundle/public && ([ -d agents ] && cp -r agents bundle/agents || true)
scripts.check-imports: node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-silent-catches.mjs && node scripts/check-async-promises.mjs && node scripts/check-pi-boundary.mjs && node scripts/check-test-errors.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: vitest --run src/tests/e2e src/tests/recovery-e2e.test.ts src/tests/recovery-redesign.test.ts && npm run test:e2e:pi -- --profile core && npm run test:report-pipeline-e2e
scripts.test:watchdog:all: npm run test:watchdog:fast && npm run test:watchdog:real
scripts.test:extended: vitest --run --dir src/tests/integration --no-file-parallelism && vitest --run src/tests/e2e src/components/peer-transport/remote-pi-integration.test.ts src/tests/recovery-e2e.test.ts src/tests/sleep-integration.test.ts src/tests/recovery-redesign.test.ts && npm run test:e2e:pi -- --profile full && npm run test:watchdog:real
